stem: Which sentence from the story shows that the trip to the campsite has been carefully planned?

options.text: The park had hiking trails, a lake, a bird sanctuary, and even a small museum. Families flocked to the park every summer, so the Thompsons reserved their campsite six months in advance.
Kim thought about what their own tent meant for this trip. She could prove how skilled she had become.
